about_the_game:
Guide glowing swarms to their home planets by drawing paths, using attraction and repulsion between flocks, and triggering transformations when the little creatures collide.

Each flock is a unique being with its own nature. Some faithfully follow the paths you draw and can serve as shepherds for more capricious companions. Others move to their own rules. They may be drawn irresistibly to certain creatures, drift away from others, or transform into new forms when crossing paths. Through careful observation and experimentation, you will understand each species’ behavior.

Technical Innovation

The simulation runs thousands of independent creatures in real time. Each responds to your actions and to each other, so no two solutions unfold the same way.

A Peaceful Experience

There are no timers or penalties. You can iterate freely until the system clicks. You are accompanied by a soothing soundtrack that dynamically follows your every move.

FEATURES:

  • 80+ Handcrafted Puzzle Levels (20 levels included in the demo)

  • Sandbox Mode with Creature Configurator (not included in the demo): Customize creatures with over 20 behavioral parameters, from speed to social tendencies, to craft unique species and let them interact with each other.

  • A Dreamlike Soothing Soundtrack

  • Relaxing Gameplay: No timers, no penalties - just exploration, cozy experimentation, and a soothing soundtrack that evolves with your actions.

  • Stunning Visuals: Immerse yourself in a radiant, ever-changing space filled with glowing creatures and mesmerizing patterns.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit, build 1903+ (10.0.18362)
  • Processor: 64-bit processor and operating system
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce GTX 1030 or AMD Radeon RX 560
  • Storage: 1 GB available space

Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit, build 1903+ (10.0.18362)
  • Processor: 64-bit processor and operating system
  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce GTX 1030 or AMD Radeon RX 560
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
